relationship: counterpart to docs/design/style-review-package (review described state + open questions; this resolves them)

decisions.rationale: ZIP components are authored against semantic classes; adopting the config lets them drop in without rewrites.
decisions.migration: non-breaking; config + --ds-* shim coexist, migrate screen by screen, then delete shim.

rules.num: Space Grotesk (font-num), large numerals only — KPI values, amounts, display size

resolution.kpiCard: Card + overline label + large numeric value (font-num)
resolution.statusBadge: localized Spanish label (EN CURSO / AVISO / BLOQUEO), not the raw semantic enum

conflictsResolved.name: duplicate-ds-alias-layer
conflictsResolved.fix: canonical = unprefixed names; --ds-* become temporary aliases, then deleted

conflictsResolved.name: border-type-mismatch
conflictsResolved.detail: design tokens are 1px-solid shorthands; app used them as colors in border-[var(--…)]
conflictsResolved.fix: use Tailwind borderColor utilities (subtle/DEFAULT/strong); expose a separate *-rule token only if raw CSS needs the shorthand

conflictsResolved.name: focus-ring-type-mismatch
conflictsResolved.detail: design --focus-ring is a box-shadow; app treated it as color + added --ds-focus-ring-shadow

conflictsResolved.name: off-system-raw-tailwind
conflictsResolved.detail: tasks screens use slate-*/rose-* stock palette

outOfScope: introducing new tokens with conflicting types under existing names
copying ZIP components before Phase 1 lands
ad-hoc per-screen patching outside the migration order
